key: The shattered glass hurt \PN!
en: The shattered glass hurt \PN!
ja: 割れたガラスで\PNは痛みを受けた!

key: Welcome to Miss Serra Voclain's mirror arena!
en: Welcome to Miss Serra Voclain's mirror arena!
ja: セラ・ヴォクランさんの鏡の闘技場へようこそ!

key: I'll be happy to assist you--
en: I'll be happy to assist you--
ja: 喜んでお手伝いしますとも――

key: If you're worthy!
en: If you're worthy!
ja: あなたにその資格があれば!

key: Hee~ Sooo you wanna say you're worthy, then?
en: Hee~ Sooo you wanna say you're worthy, then?
ja: リディア: へえ~ つまり、自分には資格があるって言いたいわけ?

key: In this place, you progress by breaking through the mirror wall.
en: In this place, you progress by breaking through the mirror wall.
ja: ここでは、鏡の壁を突き破ることで先に進めるの。

key: But be careful!
en: But be careful!
ja: でも気をつけて!

key: There's only one spot to pass through, and breaking the wrong one could hurt you!
en: There's only one spot to pass through, and breaking the wrong one could hurt you!
ja: 通り抜けられる場所は一つだけ、違うところを割ると痛い目に遭うわよ!

key: Need a tip?
en: Need a tip?
ja: ヒントが欲しい?

key: You'll have to prove yourself first!
en: You'll have to prove yourself first!
ja: まずは自分の力を証明してもらわないとね!

key: Haha~ Consider yourself proven!
en: Haha~ Consider yourself proven!
ja: ラリア: ハハ~ 証明できたって思っていいわよ!

key: In order to tell where to pass through, look for the point where symmetry breaks!
en: In order to tell where to pass through, look for the point where symmetry breaks!
ja: どこを通り抜ければいいか知りたければ、対称性が崩れているところを探して!

key: Lady Serra is such a remarkable person, you know?
en: Lady Serra is such a remarkable person, you know?
ja: セラ様って、本当にすごい人なのよ?

key: I won't let you get to her!
en: I won't let you get to her!
ja: あなたを彼女のところには行かせないから!

key: Did you know she used to be a famous model? She used to be all over TV and magazines!
en: Did you know she used to be a famous model? She used to be all over TV and magazines!
ja: ラニア: 知ってた? 彼女、昔は有名なモデルだったのよ! テレビや雑誌にひっぱりだこだったんだから!

key: Maybe if I keep working towards it, I can reach her status someday!
en: Maybe if I keep working towards it, I can reach her status someday!
ja: あたしも頑張り続ければ、いつか彼女みたいな立場になれるかも!

key: Lady Serra used to be so cool!
en: Lady Serra used to be so cool!
ja: セラ様って昔はすっごくかっこよかったのよ!

key: Are you sure you're worthy to face her?
en: Are you sure you're worthy to face her?
ja: 本当に彼女に挑む資格があるの?

key: She could've had anything she wanted, but she gave it up for her son. Isn't that some dedication? But it's also kind of sad...
en: She could've had anything she wanted, but she gave it up for her son. Isn't that some dedication? But it's also kind of sad...
ja: レイラ: 何でも手に入れられたはずなのに、息子のためにそれを全部手放したのよ。すごい献身だと思わない? でも、ちょっと切ないところもあるけど……

key: You'd think Bennett would be more grateful to her though...
en: You'd think Bennett would be more grateful to her though...
ja: ベネットはもっと感謝してもよさそうなものだけどね……

key: BENNETT: \PN. You seem to be doing well.
en: BENNETT: \PN. You seem to be doing well.
ja: ベネット: \PN。元気そうだな。

key: I'll cut right to the chase.
en: I'll cut right to the chase.
ja: 単刀直入に言おう。

key: I would be much obliged if I could battle you.
en: I would be much obliged if I could battle you.
ja: あなたと戦わせてもらえれば、大変ありがたいのだが。

key: That is, I do request to battle with all of Mother's challengers.
en: That is, I do request to battle with all of Mother's challengers.
ja: つまり、母に挑む者とは全員、戦いを申し込むことにしているのだ。

key: As I hope to be a Gym Leader myself one day, is this not the most efficient way to prepare myself?
en: As I hope to be a Gym Leader myself one day, is this not the most efficient way to prepare myself?
ja: いずれは自分もジムリーダーになりたいと思っているのでね、これが自分を鍛える最も効率的な方法ではないかと。

key: Then please, allow me to test myself against you!
en: Then please, allow me to test myself against you!
ja: それでは、あなたを相手に自分の力を試させてもらおう!

key: Ah... Well, it looks like I still have some adaptations to undergo myself...
en: Ah... Well, it looks like I still have some adaptations to undergo myself...
ja: ああ……どうやら　僕自身にも　まだ　適応の余地が　残っているようだ……

key: EL: Impressive, young ones.
en: EL: Impressive, young ones.
ja: エル: 見事だ、若人たちよ。

key: I believe you both have been gifted by Arceus' light.
en: I believe you both have been gifted by Arceus' light.
ja: あなたたち二人は、アルセウスの光の恩恵を受けているのだと思う。

key: BENNETT: I don't believe it's any such 'light,' but instead diligence and commitment.
en: BENNETT: I don't believe it's any such 'light,' but instead diligence and commitment.
ja: ベネット: それは「光」などではなく、努力と献身の結果だと思っていますが。

key: EL: And such diligence will indeed take you far.
en: EL: And such diligence will indeed take you far.
ja: エル: そして、その努力こそが、あなたを遠くまで導いてくれるだろう。

key: But, Bennett, would you believe me if I told you that you were dreaming too small?
en: But, Bennett, would you believe me if I told you that you were dreaming too small?
ja: しかし、ベネット、あなたの夢はまだ小さすぎると言ったら、信じてもらえるだろうか?

key: BENNETT: Too small, sir?
en: BENNETT: Too small, sir?
ja: ベネット: 小さすぎる、ですか?

key: EL: Yes.
en: EL: Yes.
ja: エル: そうだ。

key: You say you want to be a Gym Leader,
en: You say you want to be a Gym Leader,
ja: あなたはジムリーダーになりたいと言うが、

key: But I believe that with your determination, you could even go so far as to join the Elite Four.
en: But I believe that with your determination, you could even go so far as to join the Elite Four.
ja: あなたのその決意があれば、四天王にまで名を連ねることさえできると、私は思っている。

key: BENNETT: That-- that would be... unthinkable! The Elite Four, really?
en: BENNETT: That-- that would be... unthinkable! The Elite Four, really?
ja: ベネット: そ、それは……考えられません! 四天王、本当にですか?

key: That sounds fantastic, but--
en: That sounds fantastic, but--
ja: 素晴らしい話ではありますが――

key: As you can see, I still have a long way to go before I even have a chance...
en: As you can see, I still have a long way to go before I even have a chance...
ja: ご覧の通り、まだそのチャンスにすら程遠い状態で……

key: EL: Perhaps.
en: EL: Perhaps.
ja: エル: そうかもしれない。

key: But for someone of your dedication, I believe I may be able to be of service.
en: But for someone of your dedication, I believe I may be able to be of service.
ja: だが、あなたほどの献身があれば、私が力になれるのではないかと思う。

key: Let us leave your friend to their challenge.
en: Let us leave your friend to their challenge.
ja: あなたの友人には、挑戦を続けてもらうとしよう。

key: We will discuss the details elsewhere, and you may find yourself in a new position in time.
en: We will discuss the details elsewhere, and you may find yourself in a new position in time.
ja: 詳しい話は別の場所でしよう、そのうちあなたも新しい立場を得ることになるかもしれない。

key: BENNETT: Do...
en: BENNETT: Do...
ja: ベネット: そ、それは……

key: Do you really mean that?!
en: Do you really mean that?!
ja: 本当ですか?!

key: EL: I do.
en: EL: I do.
ja: エル: 本当だ。

key: BENNETT: Then let's go right away, Mr. El!
en: BENNETT: Then let's go right away, Mr. El!
ja: ベネット: では、すぐにでも参りましょう、エル様!

key: Follow me!
en: Follow me!
ja: こちらへ!

key: EL: Blessings to you as well, \PN.
en: EL: Blessings to you as well, \PN.
ja: エル: あなたにも祝福を、\PN。

key: All is reflected in the eyes of the Lord.
en: All is reflected in the eyes of the Lord.
ja: すべては、主の瞳に映し出されている。

key: Do remember this.
en: Do remember this.
ja: そのことを、忘れないでほしい。

key: SERRA: Welcome to my arena.
en: SERRA: Welcome to my arena.
ja: セラ: わたくしの闘技場へようこそ。

key: Maybe some might consider it vain, but I always have been rather fond of mirrors.
en: Maybe some might consider it vain, but I always have been rather fond of mirrors.
ja: 見栄っ張りだと思われるかもしれないけれど、わたくし、昔から鏡がとても好きなの。

key: They reflect much more than appearances.
en: They reflect much more than appearances.
ja: 鏡は、見た目以上のものを映し出すから。

key: I've watched my whole life painted in a silver frame.
en: I've watched my whole life painted in a silver frame.
ja: わたくしは、自分の人生が銀色の額縁に描かれていくのを見てきたわ。

key: And I've watched that same frame splinter and shatter into what my life is now.
en: And I've watched that same frame splinter and shatter into what my life is now.
ja: そして、その同じ額縁が砕け散って、今のわたくしの人生になるのも見てきたの。

key: Which is just fine, I suppose.
en: Which is just fine, I suppose.
ja: それでいいんだと思うけれど。

key: Ice is the most beautiful type.
en: Ice is the most beautiful type.
ja: こおりタイプは一番美しいタイプよ。

key: Within reflections and crystal imperfections, there's art.
en: Within reflections and crystal imperfections, there's art.
ja: 反射と、結晶の不完全さの中にこそ、芸術があるの。

key: But enough about me.
en: But enough about me.
ja: でも、わたくしの話はもう十分ね。

key: I'm sure you don't want to listen to an old doll ramble on.
en: I'm sure you don't want to listen to an old doll ramble on.
ja: 古い人形のたわごとなんて、聞きたくないでしょう。

key: Shall we begin?
en: Shall we begin?
ja: 始めましょうか?

key: SERRA: Every experience is unique.
en: SERRA: Every experience is unique.
ja: セラ: どんな経験も、二つと同じものはないわ。

key: A mirror never shows the same image twice.
en: A mirror never shows the same image twice.
ja: 鏡は、同じ姿を二度と映さないもの。

key: If you're feeling discouraged, remember that everything will change.
en: If you're feeling discouraged, remember that everything will change.
ja: くじけそうになったら、すべては変わっていくものだと思い出して。

key: SERRA: Then let's.
en: SERRA: Then let's.
ja: セラ: それじゃあ、始めましょうか。

key: Take your place.
en: Take your place.
ja: あなたの場所へ。

key: SERRA: Failure inevitably follows constant successes.
en: SERRA: Failure inevitably follows constant successes.
ja: セラ: 成功を重ね続ければ、いずれ失敗も訪れるものよ。

key: You'll have your moment.
en: You'll have your moment.
ja: あなたにも、いつかその瞬間が来るわ。

key: BENNETT: Right in here, sir.
en: BENNETT: Right in here, sir.
ja: ベネット: こちらです。

key: EL: Can they hear us in here?
en: EL: Can they hear us in here?
ja: エル: ここでの話は、あちらに聞こえるだろうか?

key: BENNETT: That's a weird thing to ask...
en: BENNETT: That's a weird thing to ask...
ja: ベネット: それはまた、変なことを聞きますね……

key: But probably, if they're not busy.
en: But probably, if they're not busy.
ja: でも、手が空いていれば聞こえるかもしれません。

key: This is a one-way mirror, so they definitely can't see us, but it's not like it's soundproof.
en: This is a one-way mirror, so they definitely can't see us, but it's not like it's soundproof.
ja: これはマジックミラーなので、姿は絶対に見えませんが、防音というわけではありませんから。

key: EL: I see.
en: EL: I see.
ja: エル: なるほど。

key: SERRA: This will be over before you know it.
en: SERRA: This will be over before you know it.
ja: セラ: これも、あっという間に終わってしまうわ。

key: Just like everything else.
en: Just like everything else.
ja: 他のすべてと同じようにね。

key: So you've found success. Hold on to it while you can.
en: So you've found success. Hold on to it while you can.
ja: 成功を　手にしたのね。握っていられるうちに　握っておくことよ

key: SERRA: I'm afraid I've already reached my breaking point.
en: SERRA: I'm afraid I've already reached my breaking point.
ja: セラ: もう、わたくしの限界のようね。

key: EL: Bennett. Step outside with me for a moment.
en: EL: Bennett. Step outside with me for a moment.
ja: エル: ベネット。少し外に出ようか。

key: BENNETT: Um...? Yes, sir, I suppose.
en: BENNETT: Um...? Yes, sir, I suppose.
ja: ベネット: え……? はい、分かりました。

key: SERRA: This Rime Badge is yours now.
en: SERRA: This Rime Badge is yours now.
ja: セラ: このしものバッジは、もうあなたのものよ。

key: \PN received the Rime Badge!
en: \PN received the Rime Badge!
ja: \PNはしものバッジを受け取った!

key: SERRA: With the Rime Badge, Pokémon up to level 55 will be happy to listen to you.
en: SERRA: With the Rime Badge, Pokémon up to level 55 will be happy to listen to you.
ja: セラ: しものバッジがあれば、レベル55までのポケモンが、喜んであなたの言うことを聞いてくれるわ。

key: Additionally, please take this TM.
en: Additionally, please take this TM.
ja: それと、このわざマシンも受け取ってちょうだい。

key: SERRA: As you probably already know, Aurora Veil is adept at protecting your team as well as looking stunning.
en: SERRA: As you probably already know, Aurora Veil is adept at protecting your team as well as looking stunning.
ja: セラ: もうご存じかもしれないけれど、オーロラベールはチームを守るのに長けていて、見た目もとても美しいのよ。

key: Until it fades like everything else, that is.
en: Until it fades like everything else, that is.
ja: もっとも、他のすべてと同じように、やがて消えてしまうけれど。

key: And I suppose that's the show. If--
en: And I suppose that's the show. If--
ja: それで、ショーはおしまい。もし――

key: SERRA: ...Who wants to bet that that was the Poké Center falling on our house now, too?
en: SERRA: ...Who wants to bet that that was the Poké Center falling on our house now, too?
ja: セラ: ……今度はポケモンセンターがうちに倒れてきた、なんて賭けをする人はいるかしら?

key: I'll go check it out.
en: I'll go check it out.
ja: 見てくるわね。

key: SERRA: Who knows?
en: SERRA: Who knows?
ja: セラ: さあ、どうかしら?

key: Maybe we got the entire Grand Hall this time.
en: Maybe we got the entire Grand Hall this time.
ja: 今度は大ホールごと来ちゃったのかもね。

key: SERRA: No rush at all.
en: SERRA: No rush at all.
ja: セラ: 急がなくて大丈夫よ。

key: I doubt that PokéMart is going anywhere anytime soon.
en: I doubt that PokéMart is going anywhere anytime soon.
ja: ポケモンショップだって、そう簡単にはどこにも行かないでしょうし。

key: Ready
en: Ready
ja: 準備完了

key: Not yet
en: Not yet
ja: まだ
